summary: Uqua is an ancient temple dedicated to the Ocean God, now corrupted by Discord energy. Its halls are flooded, fractured, and filled with planar anomalies.
history: The Ocean God Chantry was built by an ancient aquatic civilization.
Ritual chambers were constructed to channel oceanic planar energy.
Discord ruptures spread into the temple, corrupting its waters.
Muramite forces attempted to seize the Chantry for its planar power.
Riftseekers intervened, stabilizing some chambers but failing to contain deeper fractures.
The temple collapsed into six distinct sub‑zones, each with unique planar instability.
